faqs.question: What does Trisomy (Aneuploidy) for Chromosome 13 & 21 By FISH Amniotic Fluid measure?
faqs.answer: This test detects aneuploidies specifically in chromosomes 13 and 21 in the amniotic fluid.

faqs.question: Why is Trisomy (Aneuploidy) for Chromosome 13 & 21 By FISH Amniotic Fluid done?
faqs.answer: This test is primarily done to detect genetic conditions like Down syndrome and Patau syndrome in the fetus during pregnancy. It helps in identifying chromosomal abnormalities early on, allowing for appropriate medical management and counselling.

faqs.question: When is Trisomy (Aneuploidy) for Chromosome 13 & 21 By FISH Amniotic Fluid recommended, and who should take the test?
faqs.answer: This test is recommended for pregnant women who have a higher risk of having a baby with chromosomal abnormalities due to factors like advanced maternal age or abnormal results from other prenatal screenings. It is also recommended for women with a family history of genetic disorders.

faqs.question: What if the results of the Trisomy (Aneuploidy) for Chromosome 13 & 21 By FISH Amniotic Fluid are abnormal?
faqs.answer: Abnormal results indicate the presence of trisomy 13 or 21, which can lead to genetic disorders. However, abnormal results do not confirm a diagnosis and should be discussed with a doctor for further evaluation and counselling.

faqs.question: What to expect during the Trisomy (Aneuploidy) for Chromosome 13 & 21 By FISH Amniotic Fluid?
faqs.answer: During the test: • A sample of amniotic fluid will be collected using a sterile falcon centrifuge tube. • The sample will be sent to the laboratory for analysis using the FISH method.

faqs.question: What preparations are required before the Trisomy (Aneuploidy) for Chromosome 13 & 21 By FISH Amniotic Fluid?
faqs.answer: Before the test: • Detailed clinical history, including anomaly scan report, must be submitted with the sample. • A duly signed consent form as per PCPNDT must be provided. • Follow any specific instructions provided by your doctor regarding fasting or medication. Please reach out to your healthcare provider for any specific requirements.

faqs.question: What other tests may be ordered with Trisomy (Aneuploidy) for Chromosome 13 & 21 By FISH Amniotic Fluid?
faqs.answer: Additional tests that may be ordered alongside this test include: • First trimester screening: A combination of blood tests and ultrasound to assess the risk of chromosomal abnormalities • Level II ultrasound: A detailed ultrasound examination to detect any structural abnormalities in the foetus • Cell-free DNA testing: A blood test that screens for certain chromosomal abnormalities in high-risk pregnancies

faqs.question: What is Trisomy (Aneuploidy) for Chromosome 13 & 21 By FISH Amniotic Fluid also known as?
faqs.answer: Trisomy 13 & 21 FISH amniocentesis, Trisomy 13 & 21 FISH test

faqs.question: What is Down syndrome?
faqs.answer: Down syndrome is a genetic disorder caused by the presence of an extra copy of chromosome 21. It leads to physical and intellectual disabilities. It is the most common chromosomal abnormality detected in babies, occurring in approximately 1 in 800 births in India.
